info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Analysi Review-spec
info.description: The Market Analysis Review Submission API allows users to submit reviews related to specific market analyses within the banking sector. This endpoint enables businesses to evaluate market trends, providing valuable insights for decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include market analysts, financial planners, and business strategists who require a structured framework to share their analysis reviews. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance collaboration and improve data-driven decision-making based on collective market insights.
